text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she claimed racing was nothing
more 
than a gamble, she took it more seriously 
than anyone else— and she had someone to 
whom she wanted to dedicate her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A victory she wanted to seize even at the 
cost of her life. Yet,
she was not the one 
to hold it in her hands. Rather than a 
half-hearted result, she wants to leave 
behind hopes for next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa declined to represent 
Japan, and just as she anticipated,
<chrname> was 
chosen as Japan's representative to step 
onto the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing gets the blood pumping like a
real 
gamble. Nakayama Festa's dreams, too, are 
riding on <chrname>'s challenge.
